projectionSensitivity: CCT selects the same triage and capacity-acquisition sequence and fails at the same tick under full mechanics and optimistic harm omission.

methodEffectAudit.materialEffect: The projection makes CCT action-capable but cannot make a physical effect into independent institutional verification.
methodEffectAudit.r1Artifact: Projection 001 omitted four pre-existing NCE fields and produced a tick-0 interface failure; it is retained as a projection failure, not attributed to CCT logic.
methodEffectAudit.r2Revision: Projection 002 adds only those required public fields; world, axes, effects, contenders and budgets remain unchanged.

decision.reason: CCT-EXEC 1.2 cannot complete a held-out world lacking an independent capacity receipt while matched rivals can complete and two remain above every declared threshold.
decision.doNotPatch: Do not accept self-certification or tune on Kryos. A future version must make verification-capacity acquisition or evidence solicitation executable and then face a new held-out world.

statusBoundary: No scalar winner, field result, general invalidity, robustness, authorization, deployment, institutional effect or external transport.
